blocks.text: Filipino micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) often face the same challenge: they have a good product but struggle to get it in front of the right customers. For smaller businesses, limited marketing resources can make it harder to reach new audiences, while traditional advertising may not always connect them with the right shoppers. Shopee’s Affiliate Program is built to close this gap. It connects sellers with the right creators who can demonstrate their products and introduce them to relevant audiences, supporting the path from discovery to purchase within the Shopee platform.
